items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Faces A Valuation Test Following Its Cybertruck Wind Down And Robotaxi Pivot
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) just confirmed it will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas by mid 2027, refunding many deposits as it clears the backlog and redirects capacity toward the Cybercab robotaxi program. Tesla shares now trade at US$379.78, with a 90 day share price return of 16% that contrasts with a year to date share price decline of 13%. The 3 year total shareholder return of 60% highlights how longer term holders have still seen sizeable gains despite the past year’s 14% fall in...

items.title: Elon Musk Just Put a $1 Trillion Chip Bill on Tesla’s Table. That’s a Warning for Anyone Holding 1,000 Tesla Shares
items.summary: Elon Musk spent five days promising Cybertruck refunds, an extra shift, a moon factory, a Friday rocket catch and a chip plant he agreed could cost $1 trillion, and nobody has said which shareholders pay for it. Tesla rose 6% through it. Here is what the week did to a retiree's 1,000 Tesla shares, and the hold-or-trim math with the tax bill.
